scientific_integrity: Single coherent distributional theorem with closed-form post-block probability, an explicit finite bound for initial-test selection, and the full-algorithm asymptotic limit. Classical Eckart-Young-Mirsky optimality is background rather than a new theorem. Numerical checks supplement exact proof.
scientific_limitations: Real rank-two diagonal 4x4 family; two-column independent Gaussian sketches; unpivoted QR; absolute tolerance; Frobenius row pruning after a completed block; exact arithmetic. Finite-run statement is for the specified successful first-test branch. No claims about alternate QR pivoting, relative tolerance, adjoint-free variants or performance.
title: A Cauchy-law probability of nonminimal Frobenius QB rank pruning
